purpose: Test whether the pre-frozen Fiscal V2 candidate has narrow incremental decision usefulness as a fiscal conviction overlay without asset, horizon, lag or parameter search.

signal_availability.score_rule: Fiscal observation month t is available at calendar month-end t+1.
signal_availability.price_start_rule: Forward return starts from the exact-ticker monthly adjusted close in month t+2 so the fiscal score is fully available before the return window begins.

primary_pass_rule: SPY 12M must have positive train Pearson correlation, positive OOS Pearson correlation and positive OOS Spearman correlation between Fiscal V2 score and forward log total return.
interpretation: PASS means Candidate 1 clears only a narrow usefulness gate suitable for a bounded conviction overlay readiness review. It does not make Fiscal a Core signal, does not prove causality and does not permit production promotion by itself.
failure_rule: If the fixed primary relation fails, keep Candidate 1 as RESEARCH and do not retune it. Any materially different construction requires an explicit Candidate 2 contract.
